question: Which Minister led the Indian delegation in the meeting of the digital and technology ministers of G7 countries held in Japan on 29 and 30 April 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ashwini Vaishnaw**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ashwini Vaishnaw** led the Indian delegation in the meeting of the digital and technology ministers of G7 countries held in Japan on 29 and 30 April 2023.
 
• The meeting focused on discussions around the latest developments in the digital and technology sectors, cybersecurity, and cooperation among G7 countries and their partners.
 
• Ashwini Vaishnaw is the current Minister of Railways, Communications and Electronics & Information Technology in the Government of India.
 
• The participation of India in such meetings underscores its commitment to global cooperation in the technology sector and its growing influence on the international stage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The G7 is an organization of seven of the world's largest advanced economies: Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan, the United Kingdom, and the United States.
 
• India has been invited as a guest to several G7 meetings, reflecting its increasing importance in global economic and technological discussions.
 
• Such international engagements are crucial for India to showcase its advancements in digital technology and to forge partnerships for future technological innovations.
 
• The G7 meetings provide a platform for member and guest countries to collaborate on shared challenges and opportunities in the digital age.
